english_indian.native_text: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog near the buzzing hive.
english_indian.romanized_text: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog near the buzzing hive.
english_indian.note: Read naturally at a comfortable pace.

english_indian.native_text: My account number is four seven two nine zero one eight three five six.
english_indian.romanized_text: My account number is four seven two nine zero one eight three five six.
english_indian.note: Read each digit clearly, as if giving your bank details over the phone.

english_indian.native_text: Can you please transfer five thousand rupees to my brother's account?
english_indian.romanized_text: Can you please transfer five thousand rupees to my brother's account?
english_indian.note: Read as a polite request, as if speaking to a bank agent.

english_indian.native_text: In your own words, describe what you did this morning. Speak for about 15 seconds.
english_indian.romanized_text: In your own words, describe what you did this morning. Speak for about 15 seconds.
english_indian.note: Speak freely in your own words for about 15 seconds.

hindi.native_text: चार चाँद लगाने वाला यह जुमला हर शब्द को छू कर गुज़रता है।
hindi.romanized_text: Chaar chaand lagaane waalaa yeh jumla har shabd ko chhoo kar guzarta hai.
hindi.note: Read naturally at a comfortable pace.

hindi.native_text: मेरा खाता नंबर है चार सात दो नौ शून्य एक आठ तीन पाँच छह।
hindi.romanized_text: Mera khaata number hai chaar saat do nau shunya ek aath teen paanch chhah.
hindi.note: Read each digit clearly, as if giving your bank details over the phone.

hindi.native_text: क्या आप मेरे भाई के खाते में पाँच हज़ार रुपये ट्रांसफर कर सकते हैं?
hindi.romanized_text: Kya aap mere bhai ke khaate mein paanch hazaar rupaye transfer kar sakte hain?
hindi.note: Read as a polite request, as if speaking to a bank agent.

hindi.native_text: अपने शब्दों में बताइए कि आज सुबह आपने क्या किया। लगभग 15 सेकंड बोलिए।
hindi.romanized_text: Apne shabdon mein bataiye ki aaj subah aapne kya kiya. Lagbhag pandrah second boliye.
hindi.note: Apne shabdon mein lagbhag 15 second boliye.

marathi.native_text: आळशी कुत्र्या जवळ एक चतुर कोल्हा वेगाने उडी मारून गेला.
marathi.romanized_text: Aalshi kutrya javal ek chatoor kolhaa vegaane udee maaroon gela.
marathi.note: Read naturally at a comfortable pace.

marathi.native_text: माझा खाते क्रमांक आहे चार सात दोन नऊ शून्य एक आठ तीन पाच सहा.
marathi.romanized_text: Maaza khaate kramank aahe chaar saat don nau shunya ek aath teen paach sahaa.
marathi.note: Read each digit clearly, as if giving your bank details over the phone.

marathi.native_text: तुम्ही माझ्या भावाच्या खात्यात पाच हजार रुपये ट्रान्सफर कराल का, प्लीज?
marathi.romanized_text: Tumhi maazya bhaavaachya khatyaat paach hazaar rupaye transfer karaal kaa, please?
marathi.note: Read as a polite request, as if speaking to a bank agent.

marathi.native_text: तुमच्या स्वतःच्या शब्दांत सांगा की आज सकाळी तुम्ही काय केले. साधारण 15 सेकंद बोला.
marathi.romanized_text: Tumchya swatahchya shabdaat saanga ki aaj sakaali tumhi kaay kela. Saadhaaran pandrah second bola.
marathi.note: Aaplya swatahchya shabdaat sadharan 15 second bola.
